plan.title: RFQ auto title for three products and locations

steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation flow specified by the case.
Switch the default event type to RFQ without entering a title.
Apply the available RFQ template so the product sheet is available.

args.goal: On the single-stage RFQ create screen, leave the title field empty, add exactly three line items from different product families: CYLINDER WITH KEY & KNOB, AAC BLOCKS, and BACK FILLING, selecting a different plant/location for each; confirm the CYLINDER row receives Product Variant 'Default Variant', and add then remove a row while the title remains auto-generated so the screen demonstrates that the title updates after row additions or removals; stop on the create screen with the three final rows and their locations visible.

steps.note: Add the named products and locations and exercise the auto-title update behavior that no catalog domain step can express.
